I ship code, not only papers. Everything below is tested and runnable, and the two unreleased packages are on a path to public release.

## symat

Exact representations for atomistic computation. Crystals and molecules are labeled point sets over exact rational arrays, and every consumer is built on that one representation: a space-group symmetry library, Voronoi and coordination analysis, a bond-valence solver, a cluster expansion with Wang–Landau Monte Carlo, a ground-up numba implementation of MACE with analytic gradients and Hessians, and a second-order geometry relaxer with a symmetry certificate. Python and numba, with CUDA kernels via cuBLAS. More than 1,700 tests, including finite-difference and equivariance checks on every kernel.

*Private repository pending publication. Public release planned for 2027. Code walkthrough available on request.*

## Electronic-structure solver

A parameter-free, grid-free, all-electron electronic-structure hierarchy for solids: periodic Hartree–Fock in a generated Gaussian basis, correlated with gap-selected spin-flip EOM-LCCSD, with Cholesky low-rank integrals and analytic finite-size tails. Six convergence knobs with known limits and no other setting. Silicon runs on a laptop. See [Research](research.qmd) for the current numbers.

*Unreleased. A preprint and the code are in preparation.*

## mass-gap

[github.com/ColinBundschu/mass-gap](https://github.com/ColinBundschu/mass-gap). Constructive lattice gauge theory in Lean 4: about 490,000 lines with no external packages and no `sorry`, `axiom`, `opaque`, `unsafe`, `noncomputable`, or `native_decide` in source. Proves finite-truncation spectral gaps, SU(N) representation theory, and the weak-coupling chain. The uniform-in-volume gap and the continuum limit are stated as open.

## Spinel ORR dataset and pipeline

An 80,000-calculation solvated-DFT pipeline across 442 spinel compositions, run on ALCF, NREL, DeltaAI, and Jetstream2, with neural surrogates for intermediate energies and an ML-guided scheme that chooses which expensive calculations to run. The dataset of 80,000 solvated joint-DFT free energies is public on [Materials Cloud](https://doi.org/10.24435/materialscloud:ka-8a) (DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:ka-8a).
